text:
emily: Heads up — AstraThera submitted a billing dispute for INV-2026-0622. They say a feature-flagged data-mirroring job went to prod during onboarding and generated an unexpected surge. Asking for a one-time remedial credit and Net45 for two invoices while they remediate.
maya: Need the ask amount and evidence. Any precedent for Net45?
emily: They're asking for $27,900 credit. Uploaded usage CSV + infra logs. Current invoice balance = $81,300. Sales recommends one-off credit to avoid churn; customer is in good standing.
raj: Renewal in 7 weeks — agree we should move quickly. Can we confirm root cause?
oliver: Infra confirmed misconfiguration: mirror-service retried on failure; tokens consumed ~3x normal for Feb 2026. Snippet from usage export: ```service: mirror-service
period: 2026-02-01..2026-02-28
avg_tokens: 2.9M/day
peak_tokens: 8.6M/day
issue: automated retries after staging flag left enabled```
maya: Finance questions: 1) Do we treat this as contra-revenue now? 2) Do we require signed amendment before Net45?
emily: Customer says they'll sign amendment within 48 hrs if we apply credit immediately and hold collections while docs route.
legal-bot: Legal: draft amendment should be a short addendum granting Net45 for invoices INV-2026-0623 and INV-2026-0624 only; include non-precedent clause. No SLA or pricing changes.
maya: Proposed path: - Approve one-time customer_recovery credit $27,900 (GL 4802_customer_recovery). - Apply credit to INV-2026-0622 and post corrected invoice (move original to "adjusted"). - Grant Net45 for next two invoices conditional on countersigned amendment within 72 hrs. - Collections to pause dunning while amendment outstanding.
raj: Fine with that. Add cap: this is one-time; further retro credits escalate to VP-Finance.
oliver: I'll prepare RevOps memo and update AR aging once adjusted invoice posts. Billing: confirm aging bucket change from Open -> Adjusted when applied.
maya: Approving $27,900 one-time credit under delegated limits. Approver: Maya (Finance Lead). Conditions: amendment signed within 72 hours; add note to customer record; escalate any additional credit requests.
billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-0622 link: https://billing.redwood.internal/invoices/INV-2026-0622 — balance $81,300. Collections: paused pending adjustment.
emily: I'll send amendment and the usage CSV now. Will update thread when signed.
raj: Will move renewal call earlier by one week. If amendment signed, prioritize upsell.
maya: Creating internal PR for GL and posting memo after billing posts corrected invoice. Marking thread approved pending doc. :white_check_mark:
emily: Thanks all — closing loop here once signed.
